queries: Anthropic Haiku 3.5 price increase November 2024 intelligence pricing investors

sources_considered.why: Readable contemporary report quotes Anthropic acknowledging and explaining a Haiku price increase.
The primary launch page has subsequently revised its pricing text; it does not preserve the original increase clearly enough.
Primary announcement establishes continued investor backing shortly after the price increase, without proving that prior unit economics were acceptable.
The filing dated October 26, 2026 discusses pricing risks and possible reasons for changes, but the inspected passages do not connect the identified increase to investor rejection of unit economics.

evidence_items.locator: Opening section, Anthropic statement quoted from X
evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic’s quoted statement establishes a price increase under the interpretation including successor-model repricing. Its stated capability rationale neither proves nor excludes investor pressure; the historical primary pricing announcement was not available in a preserved form.
The announcement shows continued backing after the increase. Financing does not measure unit economics and could coexist with investors requiring changes, so it is not decisive counterevidence.

metric_scope.metric: Announced new investment commitment from Amazon

unresolved_gaps: No verified investor communication connects the identified increase to rejection of the prior unit economics.
The claim does not define the relevant margin, cost allocation, or accounting basis.
Continued investment and the company’s stated pricing rationale do not independently establish investors’ assessment of the previous economics.
